records.title: Need to grant national sports federation recognition to Thang-Ta.
details:
Smt. Adhikarimayum Sharda Devi:
?I seek to draw the attention of Government to need
for granting National Sports Federation (NSF) recognition to Thang-Ta, one of
Indias oldest indigenous martial arts and a proud symbol of cultural and
sporting heritage. Thang-Ta is not merely a martial art; it instils discipline,
courage, self-control and patriotism among youth. Over the past three decades,
it has evolved into a modern competitive sport with 31 affiliated State and
Union Territory units, regular National, Asian and World Championships, and
participation in 24 countries. It has already been included in Khelo India,
School Games Federation of India, and All India Inter-University Championship.
I sincerely appreciate Government of Indias sustained efforts to strengthen
sports in the North East through the National Sports University, Khelo India
infrastructure projects, National Centre of Excellence in Manipur, and the
annual Khelo India Northeast Games. The Honble Prime Minister has also
recognised Thang-Ta as an important indigenous sport of India. Granting NSF
recognition would be a natural progression of this vision. Manipur is steadily
moving towards peace through continuous efforts of Central and State
Governments. As rehabilitation and resettlement of internally displaced families
continue, NSF recognition for Thang-Ta can serve as a powerful instrument of
youth engagement, employment generation, social harmony and national
integration, while preserving an invaluable part of Indias heritage.
I, therefore, urge Government to grant National Sports Federation recognition
to Thang-Ta Federation of India at the earliest in the interest of our youth,
our sporting ecosystem and our national unity.
(ENDS)
